how: Instagram app on @withhammad.ai: + > Reel > pick the video > Next > Audio (music note). Search the sound below or take any sound in the picker with the trending arrow (↗). Then Mix audio (tune icon): Camera/original audio 100, the sound 5-10, so the voice stays clear. Next: paste the caption, Tag people > Invite collaborator @with.hamad and @hammadagentic.ai, Edit cover > Add from camera roll (the cover file), Advanced settings: AI label on. Share. Then send me the reel link (or run the after_posting command). If not posted by the api_fallback time, the pipeline posts it without the sound.
